# FounderPostAI AI Suite

Canonical source: https://founderpostai.com/ai-suite
Publisher: FounderPostAI
Support: support@founderpostai.com
Last verified against packaged releases: 2026-07-29

## Direct answer

FounderPostAI AI Suite is a three-plugin WordPress SEO system. AI Suite Core supplies the shared runtime. AI Suite SEO supplies free, reviewable SEO suggestions. AI Suite SEO Pro adds whole-site bulk runs, scheduled re-optimization, and auto-apply.

## Shared requirements

- Platform: WordPress 6.5 or later
- Server: PHP 7.4 or later
- Code license: GPL v2 or later
- Current AI provider: Anthropic
- Processing modes: managed inference credits or bring your own Anthropic API key

## AI Suite Core

- Current version: 0.1.2
- Price: free
- Download: https://founderpostai.com/downloads/aisuite-core.zip
- Role: shared runtime for secure gateway connections, credits, brand context, and background AI jobs
- Capabilities: signed gateway calls; managed credits or BYOK; shared brand context; background job queue with fallbacks

## AI Suite SEO

- Current version: 0.1.2
- Price: free
- Download: https://founderpostai.com/downloads/aisuite-seo.zip
- Role: reviewable WordPress SEO suggestions
- Capabilities: per-post analysis and batches of ten; suggestion review queue; titles and meta descriptions; block-aware internal links; a WordPress revision before every write

## AI Suite SEO Pro

- Current version: 1.0.1
- SEO Pro price: $79 USD per year for one site
- Agency price: $199 USD per year for unlimited sites owned or managed by the license holder
- Role: WordPress SEO automation
- Capabilities: whole-site bulk runs; scheduled re-optimization; auto-apply for trusted suggestion types; direct plugin updates

## Data handling

- WordPress content is sent to the FounderPostAI gateway only when a user runs an action.
- A WordPress revision is saved before every content write.
- FounderPostAI does not use customer content to train AI models.
- In BYOK mode, the Anthropic API key is sent to the gateway and is not stored in the WordPress database.
- Privacy policy: https://founderpostai.com/privacy
- Terms of service: https://founderpostai.com/terms

## Subscription behavior

If an AI Suite SEO Pro subscription ends, bulk runs, scheduling, and auto-apply stop at the end of the paid period. Previously applied metadata, links, and revisions remain ordinary WordPress content. The free plugins continue to work.
